guide.description: The Simprove User Guide contains general feature descriptions

body.content: Simprove is a performance analysis platform designed to help golfers improve by turning simulator data into actionable insights.

Instead of looking at isolated numbers, Simprove helps you understand patterns in your game—like consistency, distance control, and ball striking—so you can practice with purpose and make better decisions on the course.
It works by taking session data from GSPro and organizing it into clear, easy-to-read metrics and trends.
